en-US.author: DBeaver Corp
en-US.longDescription:
DBeaver is free and open source universal database tool for developers and database administrators.
- Usability is the main goal of this project, program UI is carefully designed and implemented.
- It is free and open-source (ASL).
- It is multiplatform.
- It is based on opensource framework and allows writing of various extensions (plugins).
- It supports any database having a JDBC driver.
- It may handle any external datasource which may or may not have a JDBC driver.
- There is a set of plugins for different databases and different database management utilities (e.g. ERD, data transfer, compare, data export/import, mock data generation, etc).
- It has a great number of features.
en-US.name: DBeaver
en-US.releaseNotes:
- AI Assistant:
    - Added support for configuring AI providers, including OpenAI and GitHub Copilot, through environment variables
    - Fixed AI scope selection for nested tables, views, and other object folders
    - Improved AI Chat image previews with aspect-ratio thumbnails, popup viewing, zoom, and scrolling
- SQL Editor:
    - Added cross-statement SQL variable tracking for autocomplete, highlighting, hover information, and the SQL outline
    - Added Ask, Always, and Never options for reloading metadata after DDL execution
    - Added "Select All" to text editor context menus and the Edit menu (thanks to @kbrianps)
    - Fixed SQL script tasks failing when writing stored procedure OUT parameter values to the log (thanks to @fizzbeom)
    - The "New" and "Import" buttons in SQL template preferences are now available without selecting an existing template (thanks to @augustocbx)
- Metadata Editor:
    - Connection type color changes now refresh throughout open table Properties editors (thanks to @EastLord)
- Data Editor:
    - Fixed nested arrays expanding beyond their actual depth
    - Fixed Value panel format changes not being applied immediately
    - Small arrays are now shown in full when they fit within a Data Grid cell
- Diagram:
    - ER diagram palettes and object colors now update immediately after switching themes
    - Fixed an error when activating an ER diagram with the Content Outline open (thanks to @zsewasdsdsd)
- Data transfer:
    - Added configurable XLSX sheet name patterns with `${n}` and `${table}` variables
    - Canceled data exports now show a cancellation notification instead of a completion message
- Connectivity:
    - Added support for more than 200 CData drivers. Users can now start a trial or purchase a license for personal use directly from the connection page
    - Fixed the "Close idle connections after" setting being lost after saving or restarting DBeaver (thanks to @zsewasdsdsd)
    - Network profile changes are now saved only after Apply or OK; Cancel discards them
- Navigator:
    - Delete actions now identify the selected object type, such as "Delete Connection" or "Delete Table"
    - Fixed duplicated icons and other artifacts during horizontal scrolling in the Navigator on macOS
- Security:
    - Updated the bundled Java runtime to protect TLS connections from certificates affected by the eMudhra CA key compromise
- Product configuration:
    - Disabling AI integration now hides AI Chat and prevents saved chat views from reopening as errors
    - Product Configuration now shows and highlights only newly available features when opened after an update
- Miscellaneous:
    - Fixed automatic updates for ZIP-based DBeaver installations on Windows
    - Fixed Git extension installation and missing Git features in Community Edition
    - Improved application startup performance
- New drivers:
    - Added the Mimer SQL driver with native support for database objects, privileges, and spatial data (thanks to @fredrikalund)
- Databases:
    - Apache Hive: Fixed driver library downloads for versions 4.0.0-alpha-1 and 4.0.0-alpha-2
    - Firebird: Improved table loading and database-to-database export mapping performance by eliminating long domain metadata delays
    - GBase 8s: Fixed database object loading when `SQLMODE=mysql` is enabled (thanks to @zerlinpi)
    - MS Access: Updated the UCanAccess driver definition to use the actively maintained Maven Central artifact (thanks to @spannm)
    - Oracle:
        - Added a separate "Body Last DDL Time" property for packages (thanks to @akmalsyrf)
        - Fixed an error when selecting a table from SQL autocomplete
        - Fixed missing constraint columns when "Always use DBA views" is enabled (thanks to @tessarotto21)
        - Fixed `tnsnames.ora` files remaining locked after DBeaver reads TNS aliases (thanks to @fizzbeom)
        - Removed nested Users folders from Profiles in Navigator while keeping users available in the profile editor
    - PostgreSQL:
        - Anonymous record values are now displayed as expandable composite values
        - Fixed conversion errors when displaying composite values from temporary views after metadata refresh
        - Fixed invalid `USING` clauses in generated column type changes for foreign tables (thanks to @NikRom5531)
        - Fixed zero connection limits appearing as unlimited in role source (thanks to @Suvrat1629)
        - Foreign-key navigation filters are now shown in the filter panel and can be removed when source and target column names differ
        - Generated aggregate DDL now preserves combine functions and parallel-safety settings (thanks to @zsewasdsdsd)
        - Replaced cryptic dependency type codes with readable object types (thanks to @NikRom5531)
    - Redshift: Added Lock Manager support
    - SQL Server:
        - Database descriptions can now be read, saved, updated, and cleared (thanks to @michalpsyk)
        - Fixed index DDL using an incorrect schema and missing identifier quoting
        - Fixed object comments not being removed when cleared in the object editor (thanks to @michalpsyk)
        - Index key columns are now displayed before INCLUDE columns (thanks to @zsewasdsdsd)
    - SQLite: Fixed metadata loading when a temporary table is named `pragma_table_list` (thanks to @zsewasdsdsd)
    - YashanDB:
        - Added a logo to the connection dialog
        - Fixed changing user passwords from the UI
- Localization:
    - Fixed Preferences search results for the language setting

zh-CN.longDescription:
DBeaver 是一款面向开发者和数据库管理员的免费开源通用数据库工具。
- 易用性是该项目的核心目标，软件界面经过精心设计与实现。
- 采用免费开源协议（ASL）。
- 支持跨平台运行。
- 基于开源框架开发，可编写多样化扩展功能（插件）。
- 兼容所有配备 JDBC 驱动的数据库。
- 可处理任意外部数据源（无论是否具备 JDBC 驱动）。
- 提供针对不同数据库的插件集及多样化数据库管理功能（如 ER 图、数据传输、结构对比、数据导入/导出、模拟数据生成等）。
- 具备丰富的功能特性。
